summary: Embraer S.A. files a Form 6-K to announce that its indirect subsidiary, Embraer Netherlands Finance B.V., is redeeming all outstanding 7.000% Notes due 2030 on June 2, 2026. The redemption price is calculated as the greater of 100% of principal or the make-whole amount based on Treasury Rate plus 50 basis points, plus accrued interest. Notes are held through DTC and must be surrendered per DTC procedures. This is a routine debt redemption, not a special situation like an issuer tender offer or capital return event.
